judge.method: viewed the Chrome render plus 2x crops of detail regions; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a red, sporty car with a body, wheels, and windows.
Draw a distinct circular hoop that is completely surrounded by jagged, irregular flames colored with reds, oranges, and yellows.
Include a take-off ramp on the left side of the fiery ring and a landing ramp on the right side.
requirements.note: Neither ramp is drawn. The only structures under the hoop are two thin grey posts with small flat feet that hold the ring up; there is no take-off ramp on the left and no landing ramp on the right.

requirements.text: Position the car in mid-air, with its front half having passed through the ring and its back half still inside the ring.
requirements.note: The car is essentially all the way through. Fitting the hoop's mid-band as a circle at centre (444,396) with r=186 and splitting the car's red body against it, 86.7% of the body lies beyond the ring on the forward side and only 13.2% is still inside the opening, so the back half is not inside the ring.

requirements.text: The car's rear wheels must be depicted as just having left the edge of the take-off ramp.
requirements.note: There is no take-off ramp for the rear wheels to have left; both wheels are in open sky with nothing beneath them.

requirements.text: Add a ground surface below the entire jump setup.
Incorporate gray speed lines trailing behind the car to convey high speed.
requirements.note: No speed lines behind the car. The only linear marks in that part of the canvas are two long brown-maroon horizon strokes (sampled at RGB 120,74,74 and 92,62,70) that belong to the background hills, and they run below and well clear of the car rather than trailing from it.

requirements.text: Add orange sparks where the car's tires last touched the take-off ramp.
requirements.note: No sparks anywhere, and no take-off ramp for a last tyre contact point to be on. The scattered orange dots near the hoop are ember specks strewn across the sky, not a spark burst at a ramp edge.
